title: Choice log entry
description: v0.1 (#110, D-032). One line of the user's choice log: a verdict on one sample file. The log is the file choices.jsonl in the user config dir (next to settings.json), one JSON object per line, UTF-8, append-only. It stays on the user's machine; nothing in it is sent anywhere (D-032). Rules JSON Schema cannot express (line format, how readers treat bad lines, matching by sha256) are part of this contract: docs/INTERFACES.md 'Choice log'.

time.description: When the verdict was given. RFC 3339 with upper-case T and an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm); no leap second. Writers in the GUI write UTC with Z.

verdict.description: GUI: 'Favorit' = favourite, 'Passt nicht' = reject, neutral = a note without a judgement or a withdrawn verdict. The newest entry for a sha256 is the current verdict. Listening test: favourite = chosen over test.compared_with.

path.description: Path of the WAV relative to the output dir (settings output_dir) at the time of writing, '/' as separator, no drive, no leading '/', no '.' or '..' segment, no empty segment, no backslash. Listening test: relative to the test package root (e.g. 'lt1/P1_B.wav'). Informative only: sha256 is the file's identity.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the WAV bytes, lower-case hex. Required (not null) for source 'gui'. null only for a listening-test file whose bytes are no longer available.

category.description: The sidecar's category, copied as is (kick, clap, ...; a later category such as perc needs no change here). Without a sidecar: the category known from elsewhere (a kick listening test: kick), else null.

preset.description: The sidecar's parameters.preset; null when the sidecar has none.

seed.description: The sidecar's parameters.seed (the params contracts' range 0..4294967295; writers emit a JSON integer); null when the sidecar has none.

parameters.description: Optional verbatim copy of the sidecar's parameters object (the exact <category>-params object the file was rendered with). Not re-validated here: it is valid against the category's own params contract of the time. Writers copy it whenever the sidecar has one; it is what still says what the file was after an edited render's WAV and sidecar are gone.

sidecar.description: Copied from the sample's sidecar (<name>.json) when the verdict was given. With parameters, the entry still says what the file was after the WAV and sidecar are moved or deleted; engine + preset + seed alone do so only for an unedited preset render. null when there is no readable sidecar (older tool WAVs, listening-test mixes).

note.description: Optional free words of the user, verbatim. Leave the key out instead of writing an empty note.

source.description: Where the verdict came from: the GUI library page, or a listening test answer sheet converted by the lead.

item.description: Question in the test, e.g. 'P1' or 'closing'.

compared_with.description: The other file of an A/B pair. Absent for a question that names one file only.

test.description: Required for source 'listening-test', not allowed for source 'gui'.
